name: A1_TS9_level
mech: Short-dated SPX put demand spikes VIX9D above VIX; once that protection is bought and paid for, dealers are long downside gamma and buy dips, so the forced-selling channel is closed and spot drifts up.

name: A1_TS9_level~tail
mech: Short-dated SPX put demand spikes VIX9D above VIX; once that protection is bought and paid for, dealers are long downside gamma and buy dips, so the forced-selling channel is closed and spot drifts up.

name: A2_TS3_level
mech: Backwardation of VIX vs VIX3M means the whole hedging book has rolled into the front; the marginal hedger has already transacted.

name: A2_TS3_level~tail
mech: Backwardation of VIX vs VIX3M means the whole hedging book has rolled into the front; the marginal hedger has already transacted.

name: A3_TS6_level
mech: Same mechanism one tenor out: 3M rich to 6M means intermediate hedges are already on.

name: A3_TS6_level~tail
mech: Same mechanism one tenor out: 3M rich to 6M means intermediate hedges are already on.

name: A4_TS3_chg5
mech: A curve STEEPENING INTO BACKWARDATION over a week is hedging in progress, not hedging done: dealers short the new puts must sell spot to delta-hedge while the flow is live.

name: A4_TS3_chg5~tail
mech: A curve STEEPENING INTO BACKWARDATION over a week is hedging in progress, not hedging done: dealers short the new puts must sell spot to delta-hedge while the flow is live.

name: A5_TS_fly
mech: A kink at the front (9D-2*VIX+3M) is event-dated protection concentrated in one expiry -- the most mechanical form of 'already hedged'.

name: A5_TS_fly~tail
mech: A kink at the front (9D-2*VIX+3M) is event-dated protection concentrated in one expiry -- the most mechanical form of 'already hedged'.

name: A6_TS9_chg5
mech: Front-end steepening in progress: same live-flow mechanism as A4 at the 9-day tenor.

name: A6_TS9_chg5~tail
mech: Front-end steepening in progress: same live-flow mechanism as A4 at the 9-day tenor.

name: B1_VRP20
mech: VIX minus 20d realised is the fee variance sellers collect; when the fee is fat those sellers are solvent and keep supplying gamma, damping downside.

name: B1_VRP20~tail
mech: VIX minus 20d realised is the fee variance sellers collect; when the fee is fat those sellers are solvent and keep supplying gamma, damping downside.

name: B2_VRP5
mech: Same premium at the one-week tenor where the option supply is thinnest.

name: B2_VRP5~tail
mech: Same premium at the one-week tenor where the option supply is thinnest.

name: B3_VRP_ratio
mech: Scale-free version of B1: a ratio does not confound the premium with the vol level.

name: B3_VRP_ratio~tail
mech: Scale-free version of B1: a ratio does not confound the premium with the vol level.

name: B4_VRP_chg5
mech: A COLLAPSING premium is realised catching implied -- vol sellers are being run over and must buy back gamma, which means selling spot.

name: B4_VRP_chg5~tail
mech: A COLLAPSING premium is realised catching implied -- vol sellers are being run over and must buy back gamma, which means selling spot.

name: B5_IVrank
mech: High IV percentile is capitulation pricing: protection has been bought at the top of its own year, so the incremental hedger is exhausted.

name: B5_IVrank~tail
mech: High IV percentile is capitulation pricing: protection has been bought at the top of its own year, so the incremental hedger is exhausted.

name: B6_RVrank_less_IVrank
mech: Realised sitting high in its own distribution while implied does not is an UNDER-hedged tape -- the hedging still has to happen.

name: B6_RVrank_less_IVrank~tail
mech: Realised sitting high in its own distribution while implied does not is an UNDER-hedged tape -- the hedging still has to happen.

name: C1_SKEW_level
mech: Cboe SKEW is the price of the left tail; a rich tail means crash insurance is already owned, so a shock produces less forced de-risking.

name: C1_SKEW_level~tail
mech: Cboe SKEW is the price of the left tail; a rich tail means crash insurance is already owned, so a shock produces less forced de-risking.

name: C2_SKEW_chg5
mech: Tail price RISING is the purchase happening now; the dealer short those puts sells spot to hedge while it happens.

name: C2_SKEW_chg5~tail
mech: Tail price RISING is the purchase happening now; the dealer short those puts sells spot to hedge while it happens.

name: C3_SKEW_resid
mech: SKEW orthogonalised to VIX isolates tail demand from level demand -- the same 'already hedged' mechanism with the level confound removed.

name: C3_SKEW_resid~tail
mech: SKEW orthogonalised to VIX isolates tail demand from level demand -- the same 'already hedged' mechanism with the level confound removed.

name: C4_SKEW_vs_VIX_z
mech: Tail rich relative to the level: put wing bid without an ATM bid is pure tail-hedging demand.

name: C4_SKEW_vs_VIX_z~tail
mech: Tail rich relative to the level: put wing bid without an ATM bid is pure tail-hedging demand.

name: D1_VVIX_over_VIX
mech: VVIX/VIX is the price of convexity: buying VIX calls forces the dealer short them to buy VIX futures, which is a synthetic equity sale. Rich convexity means that sale has already been made.

name: D1_VVIX_over_VIX~tail
mech: VVIX/VIX is the price of convexity: buying VIX calls forces the dealer short them to buy VIX futures, which is a synthetic equity sale. Rich convexity means that sale has already been made.

name: D2_VVIX_over_VIX_chg5
mech: Convexity being bid RIGHT NOW is the hedge in flight.

name: D2_VVIX_over_VIX_chg5~tail
mech: Convexity being bid RIGHT NOW is the hedge in flight.

name: D3_VVIX_level
mech: Absolute vol-of-vol: crowding in VIX upside.

name: D3_VVIX_level~tail
mech: Absolute vol-of-vol: crowding in VIX upside.

name: E1_gamma_sign_TS3
mech: Contango (VIX3M>VIX) is the regime in which dealers are net LONG index gamma and hedge by trading against the move, so daily returns mean-revert; backwardation flips the sign and returns trend.

name: E1_gamma_sign_TS3~tail
mech: Contango (VIX3M>VIX) is the regime in which dealers are net LONG index gamma and hedge by trading against the move, so daily returns mean-revert; backwardation flips the sign and returns trend.

name: E2_gamma_sign_TS9
mech: Same gamma-sign switch read at the 9-day tenor, where the gamma actually lives.

name: E2_gamma_sign_TS9~tail
mech: Same gamma-sign switch read at the 9-day tenor, where the gamma actually lives.

name: E3_gamma_sign_VVIX
mech: Vol-of-vol as the gamma-sign proxy: high VVIX/VIX is the short-gamma regime.

name: E3_gamma_sign_VVIX~tail
mech: Vol-of-vol as the gamma-sign proxy: high VVIX/VIX is the short-gamma regime.

name: E4_CONTROL_uncond_reversal
mech: NO options information -- unconditional 1-day reversal. Control: if the gamma-sign formulas do not beat this, the options surface added nothing.

name: E4_CONTROL_uncond_reversal~tail
mech: NO options information -- unconditional 1-day reversal. Control: if the gamma-sign formulas do not beat this, the options surface added nothing.

name: H1_XS_ownVRP
mech: Cross-section of the SAME mechanism as G: long the chains paying the fattest variance premium, short the thinnest. Market-neutral by construction, so it isolates the option-chain signal from beta.

name: H2_XS_RELIV
mech: Cross-section of F: long the names whose own protection is richest vs their benchmark chain.

name: H3_XS_IVmom5
mech: Long the chains where implied vol is FALLING, short where it is rising: a rising own-IV is protection being bought now and the dealer hedging that purchase sells the underlying.

name: H4_XS_IVrank
mech: Long the chains at the top of their own IV percentile (hedging exhausted), short those at the bottom (hedging still to come).

name: H5_XS_IVmom20
mech: One-month version of H3: slower protection-buying flow.

name: H6_XS_IVoverRV5
mech: Own implied over own SHORT realised: the most acute form of 'insurance is expensive relative to what is actually happening'.

name: I1_impcorr_level
mech: Index vol rich to component vol is implied correlation: it is the signature of MACRO hedging done with index puts, i.e. protection bought at the index level rather than name by name.

name: I1_impcorr_level~tail
mech: Index vol rich to component vol is implied correlation: it is the signature of MACRO hedging done with index puts, i.e. protection bought at the index level rather than name by name.

name: I2_impcorr_chg5
mech: Implied correlation RISING is the macro hedge being put on now; the dealer delta-hedges it by selling index futures.

name: I2_impcorr_chg5~tail
mech: Implied correlation RISING is the macro hedge being put on now; the dealer delta-hedges it by selling index futures.

name: I3_impcorr_resid
mech: Implied correlation orthogonalised to VIX: correlation demand stripped of the vol level.

name: I3_impcorr_resid~tail
mech: Implied correlation orthogonalised to VIX: correlation demand stripped of the vol level.
